title: Turn one $16 pine board into a wall cubby shelf that sells for around $50

slides.title: One 8 ft board. Two cubbies.
slides.sub: Wall shelf • ~$29 to build, ~$50 to sell

slides.heading: What it costs
slides.note: Typical US prices. Varies by area.

slides.heading: Build it
items: Glue and screw the 2 sides between the top and bottom, flush at the ends.
Mark the center at 12". Glue and screw the divider there.
Pre-drill and countersink every screw. Sand to 150 grit.
Add 2 D-rings on the back and hang into studs.
slides.tip: Clamp short pieces when cutting. Never hold an 8½" part by hand at the saw.
